title: Big Buck Bunny (Sunflower version)
author: Blender Foundation
attribution: Big Buck Bunny (c) copyright 2008, Blender Foundation / www.bigbuckbunny.org
sourceChoice: Smallest .mp4 on download.blender.org at 720p or above; the 320x180 .mp4 is too small for a passenger display.

source.audio: MP3 stereo 48 kHz (AC-3 5.1 track not used)

segment.content: Bunny's close-up smile, the flowers, the stroll and the butterfly; cut on scene boundaries, no peril.

changes: Trimmed to 19.3 s, scaled to 1280x720, 0.25 s fade-in and 0.4 s fade-out, audio faded and re-encoded to AAC.

portrait.purpose: Fills the portrait 528x792 (2:3) passenger display without letterboxing.

crop.x: Centre-weighted per shot (shot cuts at 3.13, 8.73, 10.63, 12.8 and 14.87 s): 440 for the close-up; in the stroll, 784 (the bunny walks in on the right) moving linearly to 470 between 4.6 and 6.6 s as he comes to the flower; 370 behind him in the meadow, the overhead shot and the flowers; then 221 rising at 72.5 px/s to 477 to keep the butterfly and the bunny in frame.

portrait.changes: Cropped to a 480x720 window of the landscape file and the video re-encoded; the audio track is stream-copied unchanged (same 906 AAC packets, no new fades).

output.video: H.264 High@4.0 480x720 30 fps CFR, CRF 20 (maxrate 1400k), 0.98 Mbit/s
output.audio: AAC-LC 48 kHz stereo 128 kbit/s, copied from the landscape file
